openers.note: Reduction opener that frames a complex issue as having a single key; AI uses to appear insightful

openers.note: Emphatic-certainty opener borrowed from political speech; AI uses to add false gravitas
openers.example: Make no mistake, this decision will define the company for years.

openers.note: Urgency-imperative opener; implies a deadline without specifying one; cross-source AI phrase

openers.note: Same pattern as 'it goes without saying'; negates the point of saying anything while still saying it
openers.example: Needless to say, the results exceeded expectations.

openers.note: Signals the writer is withholding but then states the point anyway; empty hedging opener
openers.example: Suffice it to say, the rollout did not go as planned.

openers.note: Meta-commentary suggesting the reader has not already considered it; epistemic preamble without evidence
openers.example: It is worth considering that remote work affects different roles differently.

openers.note: Bureaucratic signpost variant; 31x overuse in AI text; passive voice avoids committing to who is noting

openers.note: Throat-clearing preamble; announces the mention before making it; signals AI padding
openers.example: It bears mentioning that earlier attempts at this had mixed results.

openers.note: False-perspective hedge; AI uses to simulate debate without committing to a view; 15x overuse

openers.note: Conclusion-opener that implies comprehensive weighing without showing any; AI uses as a lazy summary frame
openers.example: All things considered, the project was a qualified success.

openers.note: 12x AI overuse; fake-wisdom distillation opener; already in prohibited-phrases but important as a sentence-initial opener signal too

openers.note: Simplification-signal opener; announces clarity without achieving it; AI uses before restatements

openers.note: Causal connector used without clear antecedent; in generic-signposting TRANSITION_PATTERNS; including here for the opener-specific signal

openers.note: Corporate-transition opener; commits to no specific direction; 13x corporate-speak overuse; also a closer pattern

openers.note: Synonym of 'moving forward'; same empty temporal-direction opener

openers.note: 18x AI overuse; asserts emphasis without explaining what makes it especially true

openers.example: This means that teams need to adapt their communication strategies accordingly.

openers.note: Hyperbolic-scope opener; AI applies to incremental developments; near-absent in careful human prose
